meta.title: ART Lab — creative studio in Tallinn
meta.description: Creative classes for children and adults in Tallinn: art, creative workshops, handicrafts, masterclasses and birthday celebrations.

hero.description: ART Lab is a space where children and adults explore different creative directions and enjoy the process itself.
hero.imageAlt: A girl painting at an easel in the ART Lab creative studio

about.title: Creativity starts here.
about.intro: At ART Lab, we create an atmosphere that inspires people to imagine, experiment and express themselves.
about.description: During classes, children and adults explore different art materials and techniques. They learn to work with colour, form and composition while developing imagination, focus and creative thinking.
about.statement: For us, it is not only about teaching technique, but also helping everyone feel confident in their ideas and proud of what they create.
about.imageAlt: The bright ART Lab creative studio in Tallinn
